description: Live insider trades from SEC form 4 filings, one row per transaction. params: since, ticker, cik, codes, min_value, limit [$0.02/call]. Params — since: ISO 8601 UTC, unix seconds, or the cursor (c:...) from a previous answer; oldest first, paged: follow `cursor` while `more` is true; ticker: one issuer by ticker; cik: one issuer by SEC CIK; codes: comma list of form 4 transaction codes (P=buy, S=sell, A=award, M=exercise...) or 'all'; min_value: minimum transaction value in USD (shares x price); limit: 1-200 Example params: {'codes': 'P,S', 'min_value': 10000, 'limit': 5}
name: insider_trades
